**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

- **Term (§ 2, p0011):** evergreen — begins on the effective date and continues until terminated under § 6. The word "renew" appears nowhere in the Agreement, so there is no automatic renewal term, no non-renewal notice window, and no renewal price uplift to cap.
- **Exit (§ 6(a), p0032):** either party may terminate for any or no reason on 15 days' notice whenever no Statement of Work is outstanding — shorter than the 30-day opt-out in our preferred position, so this sits at or above preferred rather than at the fallback.
- **Pricing (§ 3, p0013–p0014):** fees are set per Statement of Work, so there is no renewal-linked escalator. I noted in the finding that § 3(b) lets Contractor change rates on 30 days' notice without a cap, but that is a fees/pricing-escalation issue rather than a renewal term, and our 15-day termination right limits the exposure — flagging it here would double-count the same commercial term.
